title: Leave as per Karnataka Civil Service Rules (KCSR)
content:
[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Leave As Per Karnataka Civil Service Rules (KCSR)"]The leave policy which is implemented in college as per the rules and regulations of Karnataka Civil Service Rules (KCSR), Following are the different types of leaves that can be availed by the Staff:
  • Casual Leave
  • Restricted Holiday
  • Maternity Leave
  • Earned Leave
  • Special Casual Leave
[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
